title: Minecraft but Chunks are Random
description: Every chunk randomizes into a different block
body:
![View of a hilly landscape. Each chunk is made of a different block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48ef8dcfecdf6b85a32b1014494568be7741f853_0.webp) ## Overview When stepping into a chunk, a random block is chosen to replace every block in that chunk. If you'd like to make a video or content using this pack, go for it! If you do so, you must provide credit to me (Ambiguous Chameleon) and provide a link to this pack in the description and/or comments. Thank you! ## Cheats & Commands
Command Description
/trigger ac.random_chunk.set_block Changes current chunk to the block in mainhand
/trigger ac.random_chunk.blacklist Opens a menu to toggle which blocks can spawn as chunks
/trigger ac.random_chunk.blacklist.clear Clears the blacklist
/trigger ac.random_chunk.blacklist.presets Opens a menu to blacklist large groups of blocks all at once
/trigger ac.random_chunk.reroll Rerolls the current chunk to use a new random block
/function ac_cheat:uninstall Uninstalls project (data pack version only!)
## Cool people!
